core_obligations: Exactness is pointwise (proof lines 1521-1528): since abelian presheaves form a functor category with values in abelian groups, a sequence of abelian presheaves is exact if and only if the sequences of values at every object of the category are exact.

Degreewise products (proof lines 1528-1529): each degree of the Cech complex is a product of the values of the presheaves on the relevant fibre products, so the displayed sequence of complexes is a product of short exact sequences in every degree and hence a short exact sequence of complexes.
Pointer to the same statement elsewhere (proof lines 1529-1530): the author records that the statement is also available in the chapter on cohomology on sites.
proof_roadmap: Recall that exactness of abelian presheaves is checked on the values at each object.
Observe that every degree of the Cech complex is a product of those values.
Conclude that a short exact sequence of sheaves gives a short exact sequence of Cech complexes.
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the Cech complex construction, for a fixed family of morphisms with a fixed target, is an exact functor on the category of abelian presheaves (statement lines 1503-1508). The proof is short but complete: it reduces exactness of sequences of abelian presheaves to exactness of the sequences of values at every object, using that this category is a functor category (proof lines 1521-1528), and then observes that each degree of the Cech complex is a product of those values, so the sequence of complexes is a product of short exact sequences in every degree (proof lines 1528-1529). The non-formal content is the identification of the Cech complex with products of values. The claim is H1: a short reduction plus a direct verification.
